weather systems, and nebula formations, mediated by a quantum-

points spanning 35 domains, FSUFT-U with MPER demonstrates

solutions. The Fluid Spacetime Unified Field Theory (FSUFT-U), developed
by Damian Arthur Palumbo, a self-taught stay-at-home parent, introduces
a novel 10D-to-25D fluid spacetime framework, integrating consciousness
